note: Access points for the float/shuttle planner. Source of truth: access_points_source.csv (edit that, then re-run build_access.py). segment = 'river' (free-flowing Lower American River — float + shuttle), 'lake-natoma' or 'folsom-lake' (flatwater above a dam — paddle, no shuttle). river_mi = miles along the OSM river centerline from the American-Sacramento confluence (mile 0), for river points only (null on lakes). lat/lon = water's edge (put-in/take-out); parking_lat/lon = the lot.

speed_mph.note: typical float/paddle speed at regular LAR flows

access.name: Broderick Boat Ramp
access.parking_info: Free in boat ramp area - in hogher flows you may have to park outside of the area and walk in
access.walk_to_water: ~600 ft, across paved parking lot and down ramp to waterline
access.cautions: Swift water at the ramp; no lifeguard
access.note: Popular fishing boat put-in, unhoused folks are nice and abundant

access.name: Tiscornia Beach
access.parking_info: Sac Regional Parks controlled, if you have a pass you can park for free.
access.walk_to_water: ~500 ft. across beach to waterline.
access.note: Sandy beach at the confluence; life jackets on site.

access.name: Discovery Park Boat Ramp
access.parking_info: Sac Regional Parks controlled, if you have a pass you can park for free.
access.walk_to_water: ~600 ft, across paved parking lot and down ramp to waterline
access.note: To get to this take the paddler must turn upriver at confluence and go upstream a bit to enter the cover where the boat ramp is located. Also, shuttle drivers must drive across the bridge to the boat ramp - farther than Tiscornia.

access.name: Sutter's Landing
access.parking_info: Park at the end of the road to the skate park - City of Sacramento managed lot. If full, park near bocce courts or dog park after (boat drop off).
access.walk_to_water: ~750 ft. across bike path and down steep levee to trails to waterline.
